== Editing ==
This shared table is the '''Errata''' section on every Virtual Modern Alternate Image [[The Falcon, Junkyard Garbage (ALT)]] article. Use '''Edit errata''' on a member page. One column per published text state; {{tl|Errata hl}} only the words or values that changed; an em dash if that field is unchanged from the previous column; a change of the printed errata mark alone is its own column. The 0 side (Starship) has the same words and no mark on both Alternate Image versions. The regular-image printings have their own table, [[Template:Card errata/The Falcon, Junkyard Garbage]]. See [[SWCCG Wiki:Style guide#Errata comparison table]].
